scope: Required in-scope UI workflows (CauseStarter, Civility, Common Sense Majority). Workflows on other domains may still have leftover review.workflow-clarity.* checks; those no longer gate product.workflows.

workflows.title: CauseStarter organizer starts a cause and a supporter funds or signs in cause context
workflows.goal: An organizer can start or retrieve a cause, understand cause-page roles, and a newcomer can reach signing, aligned work, or funding from the cause surface.

workflows.title: Civility supporter discovers noninflammatory content and reaches a funding or share action
workflows.goal: A supporter lands on Civility, understands why listed work qualifies, and can inspect, fund, or share a civility contract without needing the generic Content Funding site.

workflows.title: Common Sense Majority visitor understands the movement and reaches a concrete action
workflows.goal: A visitor attracted to the quiet-middle thesis can understand the movement and choose a concrete next action: sign a relevant statement, fund civic content, or follow a linked CSM-aligned workflow.
